Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The players are out in the middle. Divan la Cock and Craig Williams will open the batting for Namibia. Tendai Chatara will begin the proceedings with the ball. Let's go!
... THE RUN CHASE ...

After losing the toss, Namibia were put on the back foot in the initial few overs. But they fought back exceptionally well and grabbed two wickets in quick succession. They did not grab many wickets in the middle phase but made sure not to leak too many runs. Whenever Zimbabwe were looking to go for big shots and Namibia fought back well and grabbed the wickets. Namibia used as many as 8 bowlers in this innings and it was the spinners that were causing all the trouble. Bernard Scholtz was the pick of the bowlers, he grabbed 2 wickets and gave away just 19 runs in his spell of 4 overs. Namibia could fancy their chances of winning the first game, but the conditions are suiting the bowlers and it's not going to be easy to chase this down.

Zimbabwe got off to a good start with Regis Chakabva and Wesley Madhevere scoring freely. But once they departed, Craig Ervine and Sikandar Raza steadied the ship and took control of the game. They were scoring at a brisk rate, rotating the strike well and as a result, they put a partnership of 71 runs. Sikandar Raza did perish in trying to accelerate the innings and once he departed the runs had dried up. Craig Ervine's 55 has helped Zimbabwe set a target of 154. He has given the bowlers something to bowl at now.

26 runs off the last two overs have helped Zimbabwe cross the 150-mark. They have put a respectable total on the board now. But Namibia will be the happier side after the first innings. They might have not grabbed many wickets but they have restricted Zimbabwe to a par score of 153. The hosts were well in control of the game in the middle phase but lose their way towards the end. They might be feeling they fell short of around 15 runs.
Flatter delivery, on off. Ervine looks to swing across the line but mistimes it badly onto the off side. They get a single and Zimbabwe end with 153/4!
SIX! What a way to bring up the half-century! On middle, Craig Ervine gets low and whacks it over the wide long on fence for a biggie. What a knock from him and the 150 also comes up for Zimbabwe.
darted on to middle and leg, Burl drills it down to long on and rotates the strike.
On off, Ervine sweeps it behind square on the leg side for one more.
Floated up, outside off. Ryan Burl looks to swing across the line but gets an outside edge that falls well short of the man at short third man. Single taken.
Erasmus pushes it wider and the ball turns away as well. Burl reaches out and gets it towards deep cover. The batters push hard for two and get it with ease, good running.

SIX! Pitched up again from Jan Frylinck and Craig Ervine has dealt with it. Ervine steps out and muscles it flat over the long on fence for a biggie. 14 runs off the over and Zimbabwe inching closer to the 150-run mark.
FOUR! Finally, Craig Ervine connects and picks up a much-needed boundary for his side. Pitched up, on middle. Ervine goes aerial and finds the gap between long and deep mid-wicket.
Neither batter can find the boundaries at the moment. On middle, hit hard towards long on for one more.
Leg bye! Full and on the pads, Ervine looks to flick but gets it off the pads towards short fine leg. They get a leg bye.
Length ball, on middle. Ryan Burl with a swat down to deep mid-wicket. The fielder collects the ball on the bounce and a single is taken.
Back of a length, around off. Craig Ervine stands tall and pulls it well in front of square on the leg side for just a single.
Speared in around middle, Burl presses forward and keeps it out on the off side.
On off, blocked out by Burl.
Nicely bowled! Erasmus shortens the length and bowls it slower. The ball grips and turns but Burl manages to fend it off.
FOUR BYES! Through everyone! This is fired into the pads, Ryan Burl attempts the reverse sweep but doesn't connect and the ball eludes the keeper, racing away to the fine leg fence.
Angled into middle and leg, just turning away after pitching. Ryan Burl is left completely bamboozled by that one.
Fuller and outside off, nicely driven along the ground to sweeper cover for just a single.
On off, Ervine steps out but checks his shot and just clips it towards deep mid-wicket for one more. Can the skipper power his side to a total of above 150?
On middle, worked away in front of square on the leg side for a run.
Ryan Burl comes to the crease now.

OUT! CAUGHT! This is tossed up, around off, and is begging to be hit. Milton Shumba stands tall and looks to cream it through extra cover but doesn't find the gap. The ball goes quickly towards extra cover where Gerhard Erasmus takes a good low catch. Pikky Ya France has his man and seems happy. Zimbabwe are getting pegged back just when they looked to be in control.
Commentary.Howout: c Gerhard Erasmus b Pikky Ya France

Commentary.Commentary: On middle, Milton Shumba dances down the track and powers it over the bowler's head. The fielder from long off sprints to his right and keeps it down to a couple.
Angled into the pads, Ervine flicks it to deep backward square leg for one more.
Slower through the air and on middle, Shumba works it through mid-wicket for a single.
Excellent over from the skipper, just 2 runs and a wicket off it. This is floated up, outside off. Shumba drives at it but gets an outside edge that flies over backward point. Just a single taken.
Another dot ball! Around off, pushed away towards cover-point.
Fired in outside off and Shumba can't get it away.
Erasmus comes from 'round the wicket and bowls it full, outside off. Shumba looks to go for the extravagant cover drive but misses.
Milton Shumba walks out to bat now.

OUT! LBW! The skipper comes in and does the job for his side! This is nicely tossed up, around middle and turning in. Sikandar Raza gets down on one knee looking to slog-sweep it but misses. The ball crashes into the pads and Gerhard Erasmus appeals. The umpire wastes no time and raises the finger. Raza has to walk back after a steady innings and Erasmus is elated.
This is floated up, outside off. Ervine drives it towards deep point and picks up a single.
Gerhard Erasmus brings himself into the attack.
One more to end the over. Pitched up, on off, Ervine pushes it down the ground for a run.
Back of a length, on the body. Raza works it off the back foot past square leg for a single.
Leg bye! Good length, on off. Ervine looks to heave it leg side but misses. The ball goes off the thigh pads onto the leg side and the batters scamper through for a single.
FOUR! Nicely played! Slower ball bumper, over middle. Ervine gets inside the line of the ball and gets it fine enough to beat the man at short fine leg. Ervine picks up another boundary.
length, on middle. Sikandar Raza heaves it towards deep mid-wicket for one more.
Short of a length, on off stump. Ervine punches it off the back foot through covers for a single.
Jan Frylinck (2-0-11-0) comes back into the attack.
Around the top of off, Raza pushes it towards the cover region.
Two more! On the stumps and this is worked away leg side by Raza for a couple of runs.
Raza calls for two immediately and gets it with ease. On middle, just played with soft hands through wide mid on for a brace.
This is a bit shorter and on leg stump, Ervine nudges it past square leg for an easy single.
Fifty partnership up between these two. Around the hips and tucked away to fine leg for a single.
FOUR! Wiese dugs it in short and Sikandar Raza decides to take it on. Raza muscles it behind square on the leg side for another boundary.
David Wiese comes back to bowl.
FOUR! Easy pickings for Craig Ervine. Sliding down leg, Ervine just tickles it past the man at short fine leg and picks up a boundary.
Back of a length, around leg stump. Raza hops back and eases it through square leg for a single.

Excellent fielding! Around the hips, Raza swivel-pulls it behind square on the leg side and powerfully too. Ruben Trumpelmann makes a brilliant stop to his right at the backward square leg fence and keeps it down to a couple.
TWO WIDES! Lungameni spills it down the leg side, Raza misses the flick and the keeper gets a bad bounce as well. The batters scamper through for a run as a wide is called.
Around off, Raza drives it through extra cover and rotates the strike.
This is angled onto the pads and Ervine flicks it down to fine leg for a run.
A length ball, on off. Raza tucks it towards mid-wicket and picks up a single.
Tangeni Lungameni comes back to bowl. He went for 9 runs in his first over.
On off, pushed down towards long off for one more. Zimbabwe are now starting to get the scoring rate up.
This is sliding across off, Ervine edges it down to short third man for one.
Flatter delivery, close to the off stump. Raza cuts it hard to deep point and picks up a single.
SIX! BANG! This is dragged down on leg stump, Sikandar Raza takes his time to go deep in his crease and smoke it way over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
Loopy delivery, around middle and leg. Ervine knocks it down to long on for a single.
Starts off with a short ball, around off. Raza rocks back and cuts it behind point. The fielder in the deep makes a great stop and saves three runs for his team.
Another fuller ball, quicker through the air, around middle. Craig Ervine sweeps it towards deep square leg. Two taken!
Loopy ball, full and outside off. Sikandar Raza pushes it towards cover and rotates the strike.
Shorter ball, around middle and leg. Sikandar Raza flicks it towards mid-wicket.

Leg bye! Another fuller ball, down leg. Craig Ervine looks to sweep this but he misses and gets hit on his pad. A stifled appeal for LBW, but the umpire says no. The ball rolls towards short fine leg and the batters sneak in a leg bye.
SIX! Much-needed six for Zimbabwe! Tosses it up, fuller ball, around middle. Craig Ervine gets down on his knee and slog sweeps it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
Fuller ball, outside off. Sikandar Raza taps it towards cover-point and scampers across to the other end. A direct-hit would have curtains for Sikandar Raza!
Wide of off now, on a length. Sikandar Raza cuts it towards deep point for a single.
On a length, around middle. Craig Ervine pushes it through cover for a single.
Length ball, around middle. Craig Ervine looks to defend this but gets an outside edge towards point.
Shorter ball, outside off. Sikandar Raza pulls it towards deep square leg for a single.
Another overpitched delivery, outside off. Sikandar Raza lunges forward and drives it firmly to the fielder at cover.
Fuller ball, around off. Sikandar Raza presses forward and blocks it out solidly.
Jan Frylinck (1-0-8-0) is back into the attack.
Another short ball, outside off. Craig Ervine punches it off the back foot towards sweeper cover for a brace.
Shortsh ball, around middle. Craig Ervine pushes it off the back foot towards mid-wicket.
Fuller ball, around middle and leg. Craig Ervine gets down on his knee and reverse-sweeps this towards the fielder at short fine leg.
Shorter ball, drifting it in, around middle. Craig Ervine works it away to mid-wicket. No run taken there!
Fuller ball, outside off. Sikandar Raza presses forward and pushes it towards cover for a single.
Angling in, shorter ball around middle. Craig Ervine tucks it off the back foot towards mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller now, on the pads. Craig Ervine tucks it towards short fine leg. Single taken! He retains the strike.
Another back-of-a-length delivery, spinning in around middle. Sikandar Raza pulls it towards the fielder at deep square leg for a single.
Wide! Shorter ball, drifting down the leg side. Wide called!
FOUR! Easy pickings! Another short ball, spinning it to the right-hander, around middle. Sikandar Raza swivels and pulls it towards deep square leg for a boundary.
Tunrs away, outside off, short ball. Craig Ervine punches it off the back foot towards deep cover for a single.
Another shorter ball, spins away, outside off. Craig Ervine pushes it off the back foot back to the bowler.
Shorter ball, spinning away outside off. Craig Ervine pushes it towards cover-point.
On middle, fuller ball, Sikandar Raza defends it out.
Shortish ball again, around middle. Sikandar Raza blocks it out towards the off side.
Shorter ball, tad quicker, around middle and leg. Sikandar Raza looks to flick this but he gets a slight outside edge towards point.
Tosses it up, full, on the pads. Sikandar Raza gets down on his knee and sweeps it towards fine leg for a brace. He gets off the mark straightaway!

OUT! CLEANED HIM UP! Bernard Scholtz strikes one again! He now gets rid of the other opener, Regis Chakabva. This is brilliant bowling. Zimbabwe are now 2 down. A shorter ball, spinning away, around off. Regis Chakabva makes room and looks to push this away again on the off side. But he misses as the ball turns away from him and the ball goes on to knock the off pole. Also, Sikandar Raza comes in next to bat.
Shorter ball, around off, spinning away. Regis Chakabva makes room and pushes it towards cover.
On the pads, full in length, Craig Ervine glances it towards deep square leg for a brace.
Fuller delivery, outside off. Craig Ervine drives and finds the fielder at cover.
Yorker-length delivery, around middle and off. Regis Chakabva shuffles across and tucks it towards short fine leg for a single.
FOUR! Top shot! An overpitched delivery, outside off. Regis Chakabva drives it uppishly wide of mid off for a boundary.
Angling in, on the pads, touch fuller. Craig Ervine tucks it towards mid-wicket and takes a single.
Fuller ball, around off. Craig Ervine drives it firmly towards mid off. No run taken!
Another pitched up delivery, outside off. Regis Chakabva presses forward and drives it to cover again. End of a successful over from Bernard Scholtz!
Outside off, fuller ball, slower through the air. Regis Chakabva drives and finds the fielder at cover.
Pitches it up, around middle and leg. Craig Ervine works it away towards mid-on and takes a single.
Tosses it up again, fuller, outside off. Regis Chakabva pushes it towards cover and takes a single.
Craig Ervine, the Zimbabwe skipper is in at number 3.

OUT! TAKEN! Bernard Scholtz comes into the attack and strikes straightaway! Much-needed wicket this for Namibia. Wesley Madhevere was looking in good touch. A fuller ball, around middle. Wesley Madhevere dances down the track and looks to heave this on the leg side, but he gets a thick top edge towards mid off. Gerhard Erasmus runs across from mid on to mid off and takes a sharp catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Gerhard Erasmus b Bernard Scholtz

Commentary.Commentary: Bernard Scholtz begins with a fuller ball, outside off. Regis Chakabva presses forward and taps it towards point for a quick single.
Bernard Scholtz comes in to replace Ruben Trumpelmann now.

FOUR! Consecutive boundaries for Wesley Madhevere! A similar ball! An overpitched delivery, around off. Wesley Madhevere smashes it over mid off. The ball goes one bounce over the ropes for a boundary.
FOUR! Up and over! Tadiwanashe Marumani pitches it up, around off. Wesley Madhevere tonks it over mid off for a boundary.
Fuller ball, around middle. Wesley Madhevere blocks it out.
On a length, around off. Regis Chakabva pushes it towards point and takes a single.
Beaten! Shorter ball, angling in, outside off. Regis Chakabva looks to push this away but he gets beaten on the inside edge.
A length ball, around middle and leg. Regis Chakabva taps it to square leg.
Tangeni Lungameni to have a bowl now.
FOUR! This is dug in short but it just isn't short enough. Wesley Madhevere rocks back and pulls it over mid-wicket to find the fence.
Over middle, Chakabva looks to pull but gets hurried on and ends up lofting over over the bowler's head. Just a single then.
Nicely bowled! On a length, on off and angling across the right-hander. Chakabva has a poke at it but gets beaten past the outside edge.
Excellent running! On middle, nudged towards mid on for a quick single by Madhevere.
Shorter in length, hurrying on to the batter. Chakabva pulls it towards mid-wicket for a single.
This is angled in on the pads, Chakabva flicks it aerially towards deep mid-wicket. The fielder over there fumbles a bit and a couple of runs are taken.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Fuller ball, around middle. Wesley Madhevere lifts it straight down the ground for a boundary.
FOUR! Top shot! A fuller ball, on the pads. Wesley Madhevere uses his wrists and flicks it past square leg for a boundary.
Another fuller ball, angling in, on the pads. Regis Chakabva tucks it through square and takes a single.
Pitches it up, around off. Regis Chakabva presses forward and blocks it towards cover. No run there.
Good-length delivery, outside off, shaping away. Regis Chakabva leaves it alone.
Fuller ball, shaping away, outside off. Wesley Madhevere pushes it towards mid off and takes a single.
In the air...and safe! A length ball, around middle and leg. Wesley Madhevere looks to pull this but he miscues his shot towards mid on. The ball goes just over the fielder there. Single taken!
Another length delivery, around middle and leg. Regis Chakabva tucks it towards square leg for a single.

Leg bye! Angling down leg, on a length. Wesley Madhevere looks to flick this but he misses. An appeal for LBW,  but turned down. The ball rolls towards short fine leg and the batters sneak in a leg bye.
Swing and a miss! Back of a length, shapes away a tad. Wesley Madhevere looks to cut this away but he misses.
On the pads again, length ball. Regis Chakabva tucks it through square leg for a single. He gets off the mark!
Wide! A length ball, angling down the leg side. Regis Chakabva looks to flick but he misses. Wide called.
Ruben Trumpelmann begins with a length ball, around off. Regis Chakabva taps it towards cover.

We are almost ready for action. Before the match begins, the two sides line up for their respective national anthems. First, it will be the national anthem of Namibia followed by the national anthem of Zimbabwe. Done with the pre-match rituals and we are ready for play! The two umpires are out in the middle, followed by the openers of Zimbabwe, Regis Chakabva and Wesley Madhevere. Ruben Trumpelmann has the new ball in hand and is raring to go. Let's play...

Namibia (Playing XI) - Divan la Cock, Craig Williams, Nicol Loftie-Eaton, Gerhard Erasmus (C), David Wiese, Ruben Trumpelmann, Zane Green (WK), Jan Frylinck, Pikky Ya France, Bernard Scholtz, Tangeni Lungameni.

Zimbabwe (Playing XI) - Craig Ervine (C), Ryan Burl, Regis Chakabva (WK), Tendai Chatara, Luke Jongwe, Wesley Madhevere, Brandon Mavuta, Sikandar Raza, Milton Shumba, Donald Tiripano, Tanaka Chivanga.
TOSS -  Zimbabwe have won the toss and they have elected to BAT first.

Namibia are coming off a T20I series victory against Uganda a month ago and will look to repeat the trick here. The likes of skipper Gerhard Erasmus and the experienced JJ Smit impressed in that series with the latter taking a five-fer as well. Namibia will now have a slightly difficult challenge against hosts Zimbabwe and will need to up their game in order to get the job done but keeping in mind what they did at the 2021 T20 World Cup, Namibia are no slouches. Zimbabwe on the other hand, have had a long break of about four months before returning to international cricket. Their last series was against Sri Lanka and the touring Zimbabwean team got the three-match ODI series leveled at 1-1 before getting humbled in the final game but it was a strong showing from them nevertheless. They are now at home and will go up against a pumped-up Namibian side. Skipper Craig Ervine will look to lead his side to a vital series win here. Stay tuned for the toss and team news.

Hello and a warm welcome to the first of the five-match T20I series between Zimbabwe and Namibia at the Queens Sports Club in Bulawayo. International cricketing action is back and here we will see two teams who will look to battle it out and prove that they are Africa's second-best cricketing nation behind South Africa. With both sides looking to bolster their chances of qualifying for the 2024 T20 World Cup, it sure will be an exciting watch.
... MATCH DAY ...
